content.short: 5ire is a fifth-generation blockchain creating the shift from a for-profit to a for-benefit paradigm.
content.description: 5ire is a sustainable layer-1 blockchain that incentivizes environmentally and socially responsible activity through a purpose-built consensus mechanism. By embedding sustainability and social impact directly into the 5ire runtime, the network rewards projects and transactions that advance constructive outcomes. Activities aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals receive heightened incentives, encouraging developers, enterprises, and users to prioritize green and impactful initiatives within the 5ire ecosystem.
content.meta: 5ire is a fifth-generation blockchain designed to align incentives with sustainability goals. Discover 5ire and other Blockchains on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
